Settings

Every number on the board is in units. Dollars are units × this.
Sample data The board came with example bets so you could see it working. Clear them before you log your own.
Win sound
Tap Play to hear one, then pick it. Your pick plays on every device you're signed in on. Bets of $50 or more get the whale, $100 or more get the nuke. Odds of +250 or longer get the sniper, with bigger versions at +300 and +400 (a whale or nuke sized long shot gets both).
Goldie intros Every win gets one, and a loss gets Goldie wiping out (or one of your loss clips). Regular hits mostly get the Goldie scenes made from his pictures (skydive, whip, wheelie, war, strapped, smoke, aura, make it rain, takeover), mixed in with the cartoon ones. $100+ wins get the blockbuster, parlays get their own, and +150 or longer gets the sniper. Tap any to watch it.
Reaction clips When nothing's on, this screen runs its own channel by itself: Sweat Center (the latest highlights from every league, each with its game's stat and the team's next game), The Week Ahead (every big game this week, by the numbers: records, form, scoring, trends, ESPN's win chances, who's out, and where the trends lean) and DJ sets, more music overnight. A game or a bet going live takes over. Only the good stuff, and only for your side. Your team's touchdowns, field goals, turnovers, red-zone trips, home runs and goals get a clip, with your team's own clips first. While you're winning, your winning clips play every 2½ minutes. When it's close, a music break or some hype plays every 3 minutes. Music breaks are songs only, with a card showing the song and artist. With only 1 or 2 bets out, there's more dead air, so a clip comes every 2 minutes. When you're down but within two scores, comeback clips play. When you're getting blown out, it stays quiet. Overs and unders are judged on pace, and stay quiet whenever they're off pace. Tap the screen to close a clip. Turn this off on your phone and leave it on for the monitor.
The trial replays the latest finished NFL game play by play with a pretend bet on the winner: play alerts and clips when your side scores, quiet when they don't, then the win. Nothing gets saved and it doesn't touch your numbers. If the TV cuts off the edges of the board (the logo, Exit TV, the ticker), slide this up in TV mode until all four corners show, or press − and + on the keyboard. Best fix is the TV's own Screen Fit picture size or Underscan in the Mac's Display settings; this is the backup. Each screen keeps its own setting. ESPN's scores run ahead of your TV. The board holds scores, clips and win/loss animations back by this much so nothing spoils a play. If clips still beat the TV, turn it up. If they come late, turn it down. Each screen keeps its own setting.
Ticker The ticker follows what the room is on (or, with no bets, what's live, else what starts next): every score, spreads and totals before the start, upset watch and injury news. Automatic.
Sports
Goal horn
Hockey night comes on by itself when the room is on hockey (or hockey is what's on): ice, the Zamboni, the horn and the rink.
These are for this screen. Set the TV and your phone separately.
His name
What the gold guy goes by on screen: the DJ breaks, his scenes and the intros list. Saved to your account, so every screen gets it.
Guests add their own bets
Always open: guests open the link (or scan the QR on the TV), put their name in and add bets from their own phones. They only see and change their own bets; the board settles them. Needs Anonymous sign-in on in Firebase (Authentication → Sign-in method) and the guest rules in Firestore.
Speaker delay (Bluetooth)
Bluetooth speakers play a beat late. On this screen the clips' pictures wait this long so they land on the sound. Hit Test sync on the TV: the dot should flash right on each beep; slide until it does.
Spotify for the DJ breaks
Needs full Spotify Premium (Student counts, Mini and Lite don't). Connect it on the screen that's hooked up to the speakers, the TV. Use a playlist you made: Spotify only lets these apps read your own. Your Spotify app's redirect URI has to be
Guest profiles
Saved to your account, so they're on every screen and show up when you log a bet. Removing someone keeps their bets and record.
Who's here
Somebody left? Tap × and they come off the board on every screen (their bets stay saved and still settle). ↩ puts them back.
Your name on the board
Shows in the room standings, on group rides and on your bet slips.
Player prop odds
Shows FanDuel and DraftKings anytime and first TD scorer prices right in the bet form and fills them in when you pick a player. Get a free key at the-odds-api.com (500 requests a month; each game you open costs 2). Saved to your account, so every screen gets it.
Your data
The backup file holds every bet. Import it here to restore or move your board.
Account
“Today” runs 4 AM to 4 AM, so late West Coast games count on the day you bet them.
